notes.title: Visual Novel Fest
notes.notes: It is not a pure game. It is not even a novel. You can be the protagonist of a story. Is that a visual novel?

notes.title: Released “Aki no Kaerimichi ”!
notes.notes:
I have released "Aki no Kaerimichi <Full Version>". 
It is a little bit sad love novel game using image generation AI.
It is filled with all the "cuteness" I can think of!
